ModMetaData.name: Breaking News - Traditional Chinese
ModMetaData.author: ifchen0
ModMetaData.description:
Traditional Chinese (繁體中文) translation for Breaking News by Vel1de.
Translates all event letters, settings, the Breaking News tab and the related defs (game conditions, thoughts, hediff, trader). Terms follow the vanilla Traditional Chinese translation.
Load after Breaking News. Safe to add to or remove from an existing save. One message in the event list is hardcoded in the original mod and stays in English.
